Code and analysis for Harrison et al (2026) *“Acoustic enrichment and mass larval release amplify coral settlement success”* as referenced in the main text and methods.

# Methods

```{r}
# 1. import settlement counts

tilecounts <- readxl::read_xlsx(here("data", "LarvalAcousticTileData_LIRS2024_NewPositionChanges.xlsx")) |>

  rename(plot_id = new_plot_id) |>
  dplyr::select(site, position, plot_treatment, plot_id, tile_tag_id, total_settlers) |>
  mutate(site = substr(plot_id, 1, 2)) |>
  mutate(treatment = substr(plot_id, 3, 10)) |>
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels=c("C", "A", "L", "LA"))) |>
  mutate(
    treatment = recode(
      treatment,
      "C"  = "control",
      "A" = "acoustic",
      "L" = "larval",
      "LA" = "larvalacoustic"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(site = str_replace(site, "^S", "S")) |>
  dplyr::select(-plot_treatment, -plot_id) |>
  mutate(total_settlers = as.numeric(total_settlers)) |>
  mutate(log_settlers = log10(total_settlers)) |>
  mutate(log_settlers = ifelse(is.infinite(log_settlers), 0, log_settlers))

  pivot_longer(-c(survey_title_2, treatment_3, site_4), names_to="category", values_to="cover") |>
  rename(site=site_4) |>
  mutate(treatment = substr(survey_title_2, 3, 10)) |>
  mutate(
    treatment = recode(
      treatment,
      "C"  = "control",
      "A" = "acoustic",
      "L" = "larval",
      "LA" = "larvalacoustic"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-survey_title_2, -treatment_3) |>
  group_by(site, treatment, category) |>
  summarise(cover=mean(cover)) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = category,
    values_from = cover,

  st_transform(20353) %>%

times <- data.frame(
  site=c("B6", "B5", "B5", "B6", "B4", "B4", "B3", "B3", "B2", "B2", "B1", "B1"),
  treatment = c("L", "LA", "L", "LA", "L", "LA", "LA", "L","LA", "L","LA", "L"),
  time = c("15:40", "16:05", "16:20", "16:30", "16:46", "16:57", "17:24", "17:40", "17:52", "18:05", "18:20", "18:30")
) |>
  mutate(
    datetime = as.POSIXct(paste("2024-11-26", time),
                          format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M",
                          tz = "Australia/Brisbane")
  )

# min time per site
sites_min <- times |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(min_time = min(datetime), .groups = "drop")

# add new rows for "A" and "CA" at each site's min time
new_rows <- tidyr::crossing(sites_min, treatment = c("A", "C")) |>
  transmute(site, treatment, datetime = min_time)

# combine and order
release_times <- bind_rows(times, new_rows) |>
  arrange(site, datetime) |>
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("C", "A", "L", "LA"))) |>
  dplyr::select(-time)


# ensure POSIXct
release_times <- release_times %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(datetime, tz = "Australia/Brisbane"))

flow <- flow %>%
  mutate(date = as.POSIXct(date, tz = "Australia/Brisbane"))

# crop each site × treatment to 12 h after its release time
flow_12h <- flow %>%
  inner_join(release_times, by = c("site", "treatment")) %>%
  filter(date >= datetime, date <= datetime + hours(12)) %>%
  arrange(site, treatment, date)

flow_12h_release <- flow_12h |>
  group_by(site, treatment) |>
  filter(date == datetime) |>
# summarise(date=date, speed = first(speed), bearing=first(bearing),.groups = "drop") |> 
  summarise(date=date, speed = mean(speed), bearing=mean(bearing),.groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(treatment = recode(treatment,
                            L = "larval",
                            A = "acoustic",
                            LA = "larvalacoustic",
                            C = "control")) |>
  mutate(site = stringr::str_replace(site, "^B(\\d+)$", "S\\1"))# |> 
#  select(-date)



flow_utm <- left_join(site_coords,flow_12h_release) |> 
  st_transform(32755)

k   <- 4
p   <- 2
eps <- 1e-9

known_all <- which(is.finite(flow_utm$speed) & is.finite(flow_utm$bearing))
miss      <- which(!is.finite(flow_utm$speed) | !is.finite(flow_utm$bearing))

if (length(miss) > 0) {
  flow_utm[miss, c("speed", "bearing")] <- purrr::map_dfr(miss, function(i) {
    tr <- flow_utm$treatment[i]
    
    known_t <- known_all[flow_utm$treatment[known_all] == tr]
    known   <- if (length(known_t) >= 2) known_t else known_all
    
    d <- as.numeric(sf::st_distance(flow_utm[i, ], flow_utm[known, ]))
    ord <- order(d)
    ord <- ord[seq_len(min(k, length(ord)))]
    
    nn  <- known[ord]
    dd  <- d[ord]
    
    w <- 1 / ((dd^p) + eps)
    w[dd < eps] <- 1e12
    
    sp <- flow_utm$speed[nn]
    br <- flow_utm$bearing[nn]
    
    sp_hat <- sum(w * sp) / sum(w)
    
    th <- br * pi / 180
    br_hat <- atan2(sum(w * sin(th)), sum(w * cos(th))) * 180 / pi
    if (br_hat < 0) br_hat <- br_hat + 360
    
    tibble(speed = sp_hat, bearing = br_hat)
  }) %>% as.data.frame()
}

flow_df <- flow_utm |> as.data.frame() |> select(-geometry)

# 8. import rugosity


library(terra)
library(dplyr)

# --- SAR from local normals (fast + robust) ---

compute_sar_normals <- function(rc, agg_fact = 4) {
  # optional aggregation to reduce noise / cost
  rc2 <- if (!is.null(agg_fact) && agg_fact > 1) {
    aggregate(rc, fact = agg_fact, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    rc
  }

  # slope in radians
  slp <- terrain(rc2, v = "slope", unit = "radians", neighbors = 8)

  # light smoothing of slope
  w <- matrix(1, 3, 3)
  slp_smooth <- focal(slp, w = w, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

  # 2D cell area
  a2d <- cellSize(rc2, unit = "m")

  slp_vals  <- values(slp_smooth, na.rm = TRUE)[, 1]
  a2d_vals  <- values(a2d,       na.rm = TRUE)[, 1]

  # vertical component of normal
  nz <- cos(slp_vals)
  nz[nz < 0.1] <- 0.1  # cap extreme slopes

  a3d <- a2d_vals / nz

  sum(a3d, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(a2d_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# --- main per-raster metric function ---

process_rast <- function(f) {
  r <- rast(f)

  # centre 1 m radius circle
  ctr <- centroids(as.polygons(ext(r)))
  buf <- buffer(ctr, width = 1)
  rc  <- crop(r, buf, mask = TRUE)

  vals <- values(rc, na.rm = TRUE)[, 1]

  # slope + aspect (for VRM)
  sa <- terrain(rc, v = c("slope", "aspect"), unit = "radians")
  slope_vals  <- values(sa$slope,  na.rm = TRUE)[, 1]
  aspect_vals <- values(sa$aspect, na.rm = TRUE)[, 1]

  n <- length(slope_vals)
  if (n == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      file = f, mean = NA, sd = NA, min = NA, max = NA,
      range = NA, iqr = NA, vrm = NA, sar = NA
    ))
  }

  # VRM
  nx <- sin(slope_vals) * cos(aspect_vals)
  ny <- sin(slope_vals) * sin(aspect_vals)
  nz <- cos(slope_vals)

  L <- sqrt((sum(nx))^2 + (sum(ny))^2 + (sum(nz))^2)
  vrm_val <- 1 - (L / n)

  # SAR from normals
  sar_val <- compute_sar_normals(rc, agg_fact = 4)

  tibble(
    file  = f,
    mean  = mean(vals),
    sd    = sd(vals),
    min   = min(vals),
    max   = max(vals),
    range = max(vals) - min(vals),
    iqr   = IQR(vals),
    vrm   = vrm_val,
    sar   = sar_val
  )
}

# run
```

```{r}
# ---- packages ----
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(gstat)
library(ggplot2)


global_idp <- 3
global_nmax <- 6
global_res <- 0.25
global_buffer <- 1.2

treat_levels <- c("control", "acoustic", "larval", "larvalacoustic")

standardise_treatment <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("[^a-z]", "", x)
  x <- dplyr::recode(x,
                     "larvallacoustic"  = "larvalacoustic",
                     "larvalacoustic"   = "larvalacoustic",
                     "control"          = "control",
                     "acoustic"         = "acoustic",
                     "larval"           = "larval"
  )
  factor(x, levels = treat_levels)
}

mask_to_group <- function(r, df_group, buffer_km = global_buffer) {
  geom <- sf::st_make_valid(sf::st_geometry(df_group))
  hull <- sf::st_convex_hull(sf::st_union(geom))
  buf  <- sf::st_buffer(hull, dist = buffer_km)
  v    <- terra::vect(buf)
  terra::crs(v) <- ""
  terra::crop(r, v, mask = TRUE)
}

idw_raster <- function(df_pts,
                       value_col = "log_settlers",
                       ext_m = 2.75,
                       res_m = global_res,
                       idp = global_idp,
                       nmax = global_nmax,
                       maxdist_km = NA_real_) {
  
  stopifnot(inherits(df_pts, "sf"))
  stopifnot(value_col %in% names(df_pts))
  
  df_pts <- df_pts %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data[[value_col]]))
  
  if (nrow(df_pts) < 3) return(NULL)
  
  xy <- sf::st_coordinates(df_pts)
  pts <- df_pts %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(x = xy[, 1], y = xy[, 2]) %>%
    sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = NA)
  
  grid_df <- expand.grid(
    x = seq(-ext_m, ext_m, by = res_m),
    y = seq(-ext_m, ext_m, by = res_m)
  )
  grid_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(grid_df, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = NA)
  
  fml <- stats::as.formula(paste0(value_col, " ~ 1"))
  
  idw_sf <- gstat::idw(
    formula = fml,
    locations = pts,
    newdata = grid_sf,
    idp = idp,
    nmax = nmax,
    debug.level = 0,
    maxdist = if (is.na(maxdist_km)) Inf else maxdist_km
  )
  
  pred_df <- cbind(grid_df, pred = idw_sf$var1.pred)
  
  r <- terra::rast(pred_df, type = "xyz", crs = "")
  names(r) <- "settlers.pred"
  r
}



# ---- (A) pooled-by-treatment rasters
main_groups <- counts_sf %>%
  dplyr::group_by(treatment) %>%
  dplyr::group_split()

main_names <- counts_sf %>%
  dplyr::distinct(treatment) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(treatment) %>%
  dplyr::pull(treatment) %>%
  as.character()

main_idw_all <- setNames(
  lapply(main_groups, function(df) {
    r <- idw_raster(df, value_col = "log_settlers")
    if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
    mask_to_group(r, df, buffer_km = global_buffer)
  }),
  main_names
)

# polygons for pooled-by-treatment (for outlines)
main_poly_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(main_groups, function(df) {
  geom <- sf::st_make_valid(sf::st_geometry(df))
  hull <- sf::st_convex_hull(sf::st_union(geom))
  buf  <- sf::st_buffer(hull, dist = 1)
  p <- buf %>%
    sf::st_as_sf() %>%
    sf::st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
    sf::st_coordinates() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  p$treatment <- standardise_treatment(df$treatment[1])
  p
}))

df_main <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(main_idw_all), function(nm) {
  r <- main_idw_all[[nm]]
  if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
  as.data.frame(r, xy = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::rename(value = settlers.pred) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(treatment = factor(nm, levels = treat_levels))
})) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(bin = cut(value, breaks = seq(0, 1.6, 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE))

# ---- (B) site × treatment rasters 
# priority: site×treat (this group) -> pooled treat (all sites) -> pooled global
global_r <- {
  r <- idw_raster(counts_sf, value_col = "log_settlers")
  if (!is.null(r)) mask_to_group(r, counts_sf, buffer_km = 1) else NULL
}

pair_groups <- counts_sf %>%
  dplyr::group_by(site, treatment) %>%
  dplyr::group_split()

pair_names <- counts_sf %>%
  dplyr::distinct(site, treatment) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(id = paste(site, as.character(treatment), sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::pull(id)

pair_idw_all <- setNames(lapply(pair_groups, function(df) {
  # try within-group
  r1 <- idw_raster(df, value_col = "log_settlers")
  
  # fallback to pooled treatment
  tr <- as.character(df$treatment[1])
  r2 <- main_idw_all[[tr]]
  
  # fallback to global
  r_use <- if (!is.null(r1)) r1 else if (!is.null(r2)) r2 else global_r
  
  if (is.null(r_use)) return(NULL)
  mask_to_group(r_use, df, buffer_km = global_buffer)
}), pair_names)


brks <- seq(0, 3, 0.2)


df_pairwise <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(pair_idw_all), function(nm) {
  r <- pair_idw_all[[nm]]
  if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
  site <- stringr::str_extract(nm, "^S\\d+")
  tr   <- stringr::str_extract(nm, "(control|acoustic|larval|larvalacoustic)$")
  as.data.frame(r, xy = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::rename(value = settlers.pred) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      site = site,
      treatment = factor(tr, levels = treat_levels)
    )
})) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(bin = cut(value, breaks = seq(0, 1.6, 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    bin_id  = as.integer(cut(value, breaks = brks, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)),
    binlow  = dplyr::if_else(is.na(bin_id), NA_real_, brks[bin_id]),
    binhigh = dplyr::if_else(is.na(bin_id), NA_real_, brks[bin_id + 1L]),
    binmean = (binlow + binhigh) / 2
  )
 
# polygons for site×treatment outlines
group_poly_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(pair_groups, function(df) {
  geom <- sf::st_make_valid(sf::st_geometry(df))
  hull <- sf::st_convex_hull(sf::st_union(geom))
  buf  <- sf::st_buffer(hull, dist = 1)
  p <- buf %>%
    sf::st_as_sf() %>%
    sf::st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
    sf::st_coordinates() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  p$site <- df$site[1]
  p$treatment <- df$treatment[1]
  p
}))
```

```{r}
summary <- counts_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(treatment) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(total_settlers)),
    mean = mean(total_settlers, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = stats::sd(total_settlers, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    tcrit = stats::qt(0.975, df = pmax(n - 1, 1)),
    ci_low = mean - tcrit * se,
    ci_high = mean + tcrit * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

options(brms.backend = "rstan")



f_main <- bf(total_settlers ~ treatment + speed + hard_coral + sar +
               s(site_x, site_y, k = 10) +
               (1 | site) + (1 | site:treatment))

pri_common <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = "b"),       # covariates and spline linear terms, as fm1
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "shape")
)

fit_args <- list(formula = f_main, data = counts_df, family = negbinomial(),
                 chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000,
                 control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth = 15),
                 save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
                 seed = 123, silent = 0, refresh = 0)

# fm1: vague (main model)
fm1 <- do.call(brm, c(fit_args, list(prior = pri_common)))

# fm2: sceptical acoustic prior, realistically scaled; larval prior from saturation literature
fm2 <- do.call(brm, c(fit_args, list(prior = c(
  pri_common,
  prior(normal(0, 0.5),   class = "b", coef = "treatmentacoustic"),        # 0.38 to 2.7x
  prior(normal(3.5, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "treatmentlarval"),          # Heyward, Edwards, dela Cruz
  prior(normal(3.5, 1.6), class = "b", coef = "treatmentlarvalacoustic")   # larval + sceptical acoustic
))))

# fm3: enthusiastic acoustic prior centred on published effect (~1.7x)
fm3 <- do.call(brm, c(fit_args, list(prior = c(
  pri_common,
  prior(normal(0.53, 0.35), class = "b", coef = "treatmentacoustic"),      # 0.85 to 3.4x
  prior(normal(3.5, 1.5),   class = "b", coef = "treatmentlarval"),
  prior(normal(4.03, 1.55), class = "b", coef = "treatmentlarvalacoustic") # larval + enthusiastic acoustic
))))

# compare contrasts across priors
contr <- function(m) {
  d <- as_draws_df(m)
  list(C_A  = d$b_treatmentacoustic,
       C_L  = d$b_treatmentlarval,
       C_LA = d$b_treatmentlarvalacoustic,
       L_LA = d$b_treatmentlarvalacoustic - d$b_treatmentlarval) |>
    imap_dfr(\(x, nm) tibble(contrast = nm,
                             ratio = median(exp(x)),
                             lo    = quantile(exp(x), .025),
                             hi    = quantile(exp(x), .975),
                             pd    = max(mean(x > 0), mean(x < 0)),
                             rope  = mean(abs(x) < 0.1)))
}
map_dfr(list(fm1_vague = fm1, fm2_sceptic = fm2, fm3_enthus = fm3), contr, .id = "model") |>
  arrange(contrast, model)

ip <- ps$prior[ps$class == "Intercept" & ps$coef == ""][1]
ip                                   # e.g. "student_t(3, -0.7, 2.5)"

nums  <- as.numeric(regmatches(ip, gregexpr("-?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+", ip))[[1]])
DF    <- nums[1]
LOC   <- nums[2]
SCALE <- nums[3]



library(posterior); library(priorsense)

prior_summary(fm1)   # read off the default Intercept prior: student_t(df, loc, scale)

d <- as_draws_df(fm1)

lp_treat <- dnorm(d$b_treatmentacoustic, 0, 2, log = TRUE) +
  dnorm(d$b_treatmentlarval, 0, 2, log = TRUE) +
  dnorm(d$b_treatmentlarvalacoustic, 0, 2, log = TRUE)

lp_other_b <- dnorm(d$b_speed, 0, 2, log = TRUE) +
  dnorm(d$b_hard_coral, 0, 2, log = TRUE) +
  dnorm(d$b_sar, 0, 2, log = TRUE) +
  dnorm(d$bs_ssite_xsite_y_1, 0, 2, log = TRUE) +
  dnorm(d$bs_ssite_xsite_y_2, 0, 2, log = TRUE) +
  dt((d$Intercept - LOC) / SCALE, df = DF, log = TRUE) - log(SCALE)  # fill from prior_summary

lp_var <- dexp(d$sd_site__Intercept, 1, log = TRUE) +
  dexp(d$`sd_site:treatment__Intercept`, 1, log = TRUE) +
  dexp(d$sds_ssite_xsite_y_1, 1, log = TRUE) +
  dexp(d$shape, 1, log = TRUE)

  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = .epred) %>%
  transmute(
    .draw,
    `larvalacoustic / larval` = larvalacoustic / larval,
    `larvalacoustic / control` = larvalacoustic / control,
    `larval / control`        = larval / control,
    `acoustic / control`      = acoustic / control

  filter(is.finite(ratio), ratio > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    contrast = str_replace_all(contrast, " / ", "/"),
    contrast = factor(contrast,
                      levels = c("larvalacoustic/larval",
                                 "larvalacoustic/control",
                                 "larval/control",
                                 "acoustic/control"))
  )

contr_summary <- contr_draws %>%
  group_by(contrast) %>%
  summarise(
    median  = median(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    low95   = quantile(ratio, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi95    = quantile(ratio, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pr_gt1  = mean(ratio > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    medianlabel = paste0("x", round(median, 1)),
    pr_label    = sprintf("Pr(>1)=%.2f", Pr_gt1)
  )


inla_dat_df_site <- counts_df |> group_by(treatment, site) |> summarise(settlers=mean(exp(log_settlers)))

# ---- raw-scale increment draws ----------------------------------------------
raw_inc_draws <- epred_pop %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = .epred) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    .draw,
    C  = control,
    L  = larval,
    A  = acoustic,
    LA = larvalacoustic,
    inc_L   = L  - C,
    inc_A   = A  - C,
    inc_LA  = LA - C,
    inc_add = inc_L + inc_A,               # additive expectation (raw scale)
    d_inc   = inc_LA - inc_add,            # difference (0 = raw-additive)
    OE_inc  = inc_LA / pmax(inc_add, 1e-9) # ratio (1 = raw-additive); guard small denom
  )

# ---- medians for label positions --------------------------------------------
median_df <- raw_inc_draws %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `observed increment (LA - C)`            = inc_LA,
    `additive increment ((L - C) + (A - C))` = inc_add
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::everything(),
    names_to  = "contrast",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(value > 0) %>%   # keep only positive (log10 scale)
  dplyr::group_by(contrast) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median  = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- plot: expected counts (log scale) ----

    , linewidth = 0.15,

  # geom_point(data = inla_dat_df_site,

     geom_errorbar(data = pop_sum,
                aes(x = fct_inorder(treatment), y = .epred, ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper),
                width = 0, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(data = pop_sum,
             aes(x = fct_inorder(treatment), y = .epred, fill = treatment),
             size = 2, shape = 21, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Predicted settlers (population-level)") +
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=scales::brewer_pal(palette = "YlGnBu")(4)[1:4])
#  scale_fill_manual(values=c("coral", "yellow", "mediumturquoise", "deepskyblue"), name="")
#coralcolors::scale_fill_coral(palette = "acropora2")
library(scales)
# ---- plot: density ridges of contrasts (log-x) with Pr(ratio>1) annotations ----
densityridges <- ggplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(
    data = contr_draws,
    aes(x = ratio, y = contrast, fill = contrast),
    geom = "density_ridges", show.legend = FALSE, quantile_lines = TRUE, linetype = "dotted",
    rel_min_height = 0.0005, alpha = 0.45, scale = 0.7, linewidth = 0.25
  ) + 
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(
    data = contr_draws,
    aes(x = ratio, y = contrast), fill = NA,
    geom = "density_ridges", show.legend = FALSE, quantile_lines = FALSE,
    rel_min_height = 0.0005, alpha = 0.75, scale = 0.7, linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_text(data = contr_summary,
            aes(x = median, y = contrast, label = medianlabel),
            size = 2.5, nudge_y = 0.25) +
  geom_text(data = contr_summary,
            aes(x = hi95, y = contrast, label = pr_label),
            size = 2.4, nudge_y = -0.1) +
   ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    trans = "log10",
    limits = c(0.1, 500),
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100),
    labels = c("1", "10", "100")
  ) +
 scale_y_discrete(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.4))  # adds internal padding below lowest ridge
  ) +
  labs(x = "Expected settlers ratio (log scale)", y = "Treatment contrasts") +
  theme_bw() +
 
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    #panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),

    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_blank()
  ) +  scale_fill_manual(values=rev(brewer_pal(palette = "YlGnBu")(5)[2:5]))
```

## Fig S3. Site distances

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 9


library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

# pairwise distance matrix (m) across ALL rows (no site restriction)
D <- st_distance(site_coords) |> as.matrix()

n <- nrow(site_coords)
diag(D) <- Inf

nn_idx  <- apply(D, 1, which.min)
nn_dist <- D[cbind(seq_len(n), nn_idx)]
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(kableExtra)

rope_limits <- c(-0.1, 0.1)

# Fixed effects, spatial coefficients, random-effect SDs,
# smooth SD and negative binomial shape
draws <- as_draws_df(fm1)

parameter_names <- variables(draws) |>
  str_subset("^(b_|sd_|sds_|shape$)")

selected_draws <- subset_draws(
  draws,
  variable = parameter_names
)

# Posterior summaries and diagnostics
posterior_tbl <- summarise_draws(
  selected_draws,
  mean,
  sd,
  ~ quantile(.x, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)),
  rhat,
  ess_bulk,
  ess_tail
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(
    Estimate = mean,
    SE = sd,
    CI_low = `2.5%`,
    CI_high = `97.5%`
  )

# Full-posterior probability of direction and ROPE proportion
rope_tbl <- selected_draws |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(all_of(parameter_names)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    pd = max(mean(value > 0), mean(value < 0)),
    ROPE = mean(
      value >= rope_limits[1] &
        value <= rope_limits[2]
    ),
    .by = variable
  )

# Assemble Table S2
s2_tbl <- posterior_tbl |>
  left_join(rope_tbl, by = "variable") |>
  mutate(
    section = case_when(
      str_detect(variable, "^b_s") ~ "Spatial coefficients",
      str_detect(variable, "^b_") ~ "Fixed effects",
      TRUE ~ "Hyperparameters"
    ),
    term = str_remove(variable, "^b_"),
    IRR = if_else(
      section == "Fixed effects", exp(Estimate), NA_real_
    ),
    IRR_low = if_else(
      section == "Fixed effects", exp(CI_low), NA_real_
    ),
    IRR_high = if_else(
      section == "Fixed effects", exp(CI_high), NA_real_
    ),
    # Direction relative to zero is uninformative for positive parameters
    pd = if_else(section == "Hyperparameters", NA_real_, pd),
    section = factor(
      section,
      levels = c(
        "Fixed effects", "Spatial coefficients", "Hyperparameters"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(section) |>
  select(
    section, term, Estimate, SE, CI_low, CI_high,
    IRR, IRR_low, IRR_high, rhat, ess_bulk, ess_tail,
    pd, ROPE
  )

s2_tbl |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(pd, ROPE),
      ~ if_else(
        is.na(.x), "", sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * .x)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  kbl(
    format = "html",
    caption = paste0(
      "Table S2. Posterior summaries with 95% credible intervals. ",
      "%ROPE uses all posterior draws within [",
      paste(rope_limits, collapse = ", "),
      "]. Hyperparameter ROPE values use their native scales."
    ),
    col.names = c(
      "Block", "Term", "Estimate", "SE",
      "95% CI low", "95% CI high",
      "IRR", "IRR 95% low", "IRR 95% high",
      "Rhat", "Bulk ESS", "Tail ESS", "pd", "%ROPE"
    ),
    digits = c(
      0, 0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3, 0, 0, 2, 2
    ),
    escape = TRUE
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed")
  ) |>
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") |>
  add_header_above(
    c(
      " " = 2,
      "Posterior" = 4,
      "IRR (fixed only)" = 3,
      "Diagnostics" = 3,
      "Posterior probabilities" = 2
    )
  )

```

## Tab. S2 Model output & posterior predictive check (grouped means)

```{r}

library(brms)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

fit <- fm1
s   <- summary(fit)

fmt_block <- function(x, section) {
  x %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    mutate(section = section) %>%
    select(section, term, Estimate, Est.Error, `l-95% CI`, `u-95% CI`, Rhat, Bulk_ESS, Tail_ESS) %>%
    rename(
      SE      = Est.Error,
      CI_low  = `l-95% CI`,
      CI_high = `u-95% CI`
    )
}

fixed_tbl <- fmt_block(s$fixed, "Fixed effects") %>%
  mutate(
    IRR     = exp(Estimate),
    IRR_low = exp(CI_low),
    IRR_hi  = exp(CI_high)
  )

sds_tbl <- if (!is.null(s$sds) && nrow(as.data.frame(s$sds)) > 0) {
  fmt_block(s$sds, "Smooth hyperparameters") %>%
    mutate(term = str_replace(term, "^sds\\((.*)\\)$", "sds(\\1)"))
} else {
  tibble()
}

rand_tbl <- if (!is.null(s$random) && "site" %in% names(s$random) && nrow(as.data.frame(s$random$site)) > 0) {
  fmt_block(s$random$site, "Random effects (site)") %>%
    mutate(term = str_replace(term, "^sd\\((.*)\\)$", "sd_site(\\1)"))
} else {
  tibble()
}

spec_tbl <- if (!is.null(s$spec_pars) && nrow(as.data.frame(s$spec_pars)) > 0) {
  fmt_block(s$spec_pars, "Distributional") %>%
    mutate(term = str_replace(term, "^shape$", "shape (negbin)"))
} else {
  tibble()
}

pub_tbl <- bind_rows(fixed_tbl, sds_tbl, rand_tbl, spec_tbl) %>%
  mutate(
    term = term %>%
      str_replace("^Intercept$", "(Intercept)") %>%
      str_replace("^treatment", "treatment: ") %>%
      str_replace("^ssite_xsite_y_([0-9]+)$", "s(site_x, site_y)[\\1]")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Estimate, SE, CI_low, CI_high, Rhat), ~ round(.x, 2)),
    across(c(Bulk_ESS, Tail_ESS), ~ round(.x, 0)),
    across(c(IRR, IRR_low, IRR_hi), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )

caption_txt <- paste0(
  "Negative binomial model (log link). N = ", s$nobs,
  ". Formula: total_settlers ~ treatment + speed + hard_coral + sar + s(site_x, site_y, k = 23) + (1 | site)."
)

library(kableExtra)

pub_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    IRR = if_else(section == "Fixed effects", as.character(IRR), NA_character_),
    IRR_low = if_else(section == "Fixed effects", as.character(IRR_low), NA_character_),
    IRR_hi = if_else(section == "Fixed effects", as.character(IRR_hi), NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = caption_txt,
    col.names = c("Block", "Term", "Estimate", "SE", "95% CI low", "95% CI high", "IRR", "IRR 95% low", "IRR 95% high", "Rhat", "Bulk ESS", "Tail ESS"),
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed")) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Posterior (log scale)" = 4, "IRR (fixed only)" = 3, "Diagnostics" = 3))
```

## Tab. S3. Spatial autocorrelation tests

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-width: 10
#| 

library(tidybayes)
library(spdep)

# 1) Newdata aligned to the fitted model (includes site/treatment + scaled covariates)
df0 <- counts_df %>%
  dplyr::select(total_settlers, site, treatment, hard_coral, 
                speed, sar, site_x, site_y) %>% #, tile_x, tile_y) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(.row = row_number())

# 2) Posterior expected means (includes site REs & smooth)
ep_incRE <- add_epred_draws(df0, fm1, re_formula = NULL)

res_mu_incRE <- ep_incRE %>%
  group_by(.row) %>%
  summarise(mu_hat = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(df0, by = ".row") %>%
  mutate(resid = total_settlers - mu_hat)

# # compute residuals EXCLUDING REs (population-level field)
# ep_noRE <- add_epred_draws(df0, fit_sp1, re_formula = NA)
# 
# res_mu_noRE <- ep_noRE %>%
#   group_by(.row) %>%
#   summarise(mu_hat = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
#   left_join(df0, by = ".row") %>%
#   mutate(resid = total_settlers - mu_hat)

# 3) Build a connected neighbour graph automatically (k-NN, symmetrised)
find_connected_knn <- function(coords, k_min = 8, k_max = 30) {
  for (k in k_min:k_max) {
    knn <- spdep::knearneigh(coords, k = k)
    nb  <- spdep::knn2nb(knn, sym = TRUE)
    if (spdep::n.comp.nb(nb)$nc == 1) return(list(nb = nb, k = k))
  }
  knn <- spdep::knearneigh(coords, k = k_max)
  nb  <- spdep::knn2nb(knn, sym = TRUE)
  list(nb = nb, k = k_max)
}

coords_mat <- as.matrix(df0[, c("site_x","site_y")])
cn <- find_connected_knn(coords_mat, k_min = 8, k_max = 30)
lw <- spdep::nb2listw(cn$nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)


# 4) Moran's I on residuals
moran_incRE <- spdep::moran.test(res_mu_incRE$resid, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)

moran_test <- moran_incRE

moran_tbl <- as_tibble_row(
  set_names(
    as.numeric(moran_test$estimate),
    c("Moran I statistic", "Expectation", "Variance")
  )
)

moran_tbl |>
  kbl(
    format = "html",
    caption = sprintf(
      "Moran I statistic standard deviate = %.4f, p-value = %.4f",
      unname(moran_test$statistic),
      moran_test$p.value
    ),
    digits = c(3, 3, 4),
    escape = TRUE
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed")
  )
```

```{r}
library(posterior); library(priorsense)

ps_split <- function(fit, tr) {
  # tr: list of c(mean, sd) for each treatment coefficient
  d  <- as_draws_df(fit)
  ps <- prior_summary(fit)
  ip <- ps$prior[ps$class == "Intercept" & ps$coef == ""][1]
  n  <- as.numeric(regmatches(ip, gregexpr("-?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+", ip))[[1]])
  DF <- n[1]; LOC <- n[2]; SCALE <- n[3]
  
  lp_treat <- dnorm(d$b_treatmentacoustic,       tr$acoustic[1],       tr$acoustic[2],       log = TRUE) +
    dnorm(d$b_treatmentlarval,         tr$larval[1],         tr$larval[2],         log = TRUE) +
    dnorm(d$b_treatmentlarvalacoustic, tr$larvalacoustic[1], tr$larvalacoustic[2], log = TRUE)
  
  lp_other <- dnorm(d$b_speed,            0, 2, log = TRUE) +
    dnorm(d$b_hard_coral,       0, 2, log = TRUE) +
    dnorm(d$b_sar,              0, 2, log = TRUE) +
    dnorm(d$bs_ssite_xsite_y_1, 0, 2, log = TRUE) +
    dnorm(d$bs_ssite_xsite_y_2, 0, 2, log = TRUE) +
    dt((d$Intercept - LOC) / SCALE, df = DF, log = TRUE) - log(SCALE)
  
  lp_var <- dexp(d$sd_site__Intercept,             1, log = TRUE) +
    dexp(d$`sd_site:treatment__Intercept`, 1, log = TRUE) +
    dexp(d$sds_ssite_xsite_y_1,            1, log = TRUE) +
    dexp(d$shape,                          1, log = TRUE)
  
  stopifnot(length(lp_treat) == nrow(d), length(lp_other) == nrow(d), length(lp_var) == nrow(d))
  
  ll   <- log_lik(fit)
  colnames(ll) <- paste0("log_lik[", seq_len(ncol(ll)), "]")
  vars <- c("b_treatmentacoustic", "b_treatmentlarval", "b_treatmentlarvalacoustic")
  
  dr <- data.frame(as.data.frame(subset_draws(d, variable = vars)),
                   `lprior[1]` = lp_treat, `lprior[2]` = lp_other, `lprior[3]` = lp_var,
                   ll, check.names = FALSE) |>
    as_draws_df()
  
  bind_rows(
    as_tibble(powerscale_sensitivity(dr, prior_selection = 1)) |> mutate(prior_group = "treatment"),
    as_tibble(powerscale_sensitivity(dr, prior_selection = 3)) |> mutate(prior_group = "sd/sds/shape")
  )
}

tr_fm1 <- list(acoustic = c(0, 2),      larval = c(0, 2),     larvalacoustic = c(0, 2))
tr_fm2 <- list(acoustic = c(0, 0.5),    larval = c(3.5, 1.5), larvalacoustic = c(3.5, 1.6))
tr_fm3 <- list(acoustic = c(0.53, 0.35), larval = c(3.5, 1.5), larvalacoustic = c(4.03, 1.55))

ps_all <- bind_rows(
  ps_split(fm1, tr_fm1) |> mutate(model = "fm1_vague"),
  ps_split(fm2, tr_fm2) |> mutate(model = "fm2_sceptic"),
  ps_split(fm3, tr_fm3) |> mutate(model = "fm3_enthus")
) |>
  select(model, prior_group, variable, prior, likelihood, diagnosis) |>
  arrange(prior_group, variable, model)

ps_all %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Prior sensitivity analysis"
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )

```

## Tab. S5

```{r}
tab_sz <- ps_all |>
  mutate(effect = recode(variable,
                         b_treatmentacoustic       = "Acoustic",
                         b_treatmentlarval         = "Larval",
                         b_treatmentlarvalacoustic = "Larval + acoustic"),
         model = sub("_.*", "", model)) |>
  select(effect, model, prior_group, prior, likelihood) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = prior_group, values_from = prior) |>
  select(effect, model,
         prior_treatment = treatment,
         prior_variance  = `sd/sds/shape`,
         likelihood) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  arrange(factor(effect, levels = c("Acoustic", "Larval", "Larval + acoustic")), model)

tab_sz %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Prior sensitivity analysis"
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )
```

## Tab. S6

```{r}



# prediction grid: one row per treatment at mean covariates and mean plot location
nd <- tibble(
  treatment  = factor(c("control", "acoustic", "larval", "larvalacoustic"),
                      levels = levels(counts_df$treatment)),
  speed      = mean(counts_df$speed),
  hard_coral = mean(counts_df$hard_coral),
  sar        = mean(counts_df$sar),
  site_x     = mean(counts_df$site_x),
  site_y     = mean(counts_df$site_y)
)

summ <- function(x, ref, type = c("ratio", "diff")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  tibble(
    median = median(x),
    lo     = quantile(x, 0.025),
    hi     = quantile(x, 0.975),
    pd     = max(mean(x > ref), mean(x < ref)),
    rope   = if (type == "ratio") 100 * mean(abs(log(x)) < 0.1) else NA_real_
  )
}

table_sx <- function(m) {
  ep <- posterior_epred(m, newdata = nd, re_formula = NA)   # draws x 4
  C  <- ep[, 1]; A <- ep[, 2]; L <- ep[, 3]; LA <- ep[, 4]
  
  inc_add <- (L - C) + (A - C)
  inc_LA  <- LA - C
  
  bind_rows(
    summ(A / C,             ref = 1, "ratio") |> mutate(contrast = "C-A"),
    summ(L / C,             ref = 1, "ratio") |> mutate(contrast = "C-L"),
    summ(LA / L,            ref = 1, "ratio") |> mutate(contrast = "L-LA"),
    summ(inc_LA - inc_add,  ref = 0, "diff")  |> mutate(contrast = "d_inc"),
    summ(inc_LA / inc_add,  ref = 1, "ratio") |> mutate(contrast = "OE_inc")
  )
}

prior_lab <- tibble(
  model          = c("fm1", "fm2", "fm3"),
  acoustic_prior = c("N(0, 2)", "N(0, 0.5)",   "N(0.53, 0.35)"),
  larval_prior   = c("N(0, 2)", "N(3.5, 1.5)", "N(3.5, 1.5)")
)

tab_sx <- map_dfr(list(fm1 = fm1, fm2 = fm2, fm3 = fm3), table_sx, .id = "model") |>
  left_join(prior_lab, by = "model") |>
  mutate(
    median = signif(median, 3),
    CrI    = paste0(signif(lo, 3), " to ", signif(hi, 3)),
    pd     = round(pd, 3),
    rope   = round(rope, 1)
  ) |>
  select(contrast, model, acoustic_prior, larval_prior, median, CrI, pd, rope) |>
  arrange(factor(contrast, levels = c("C-A", "C-L", "L-LA", "d_inc", "OE_inc")), model)

tab_sx %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Prior sensitivity analysis"
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )

```
